summary: Authoritative, shareable master architectural specification and technical implementation plan for building an In-WhatsApp Message Scheduler Chatbot. Covers platform feasibility, Meta policy constraints, dual conversational UX, PostgreSQL 14+ production DDL, two-tier hybrid scheduling (Feeder + BullMQ), wall-clock DST invariance, zero-double-send idempotency, anti-ban heuristics, and a 5-phase engineering roadmap.
